name: Seed Junky Pre-Roll | Banana Fruz
description: Banana Fruz is a flavorful hybrid that embodies the essence of tropical bananas, blended with creamy vanilla and hints of berry and citrus. Its balanced potency provides an uplifting euphoria followed by a gentle wave of relaxation, making it a go-to choice for any moment.
